**Cadence** is a high-performance, internal project management and workspace platform inspired by tools like Jira and Trello. It features a decoupled architecture with a NestJS and PostgreSQL backend alongside a Next.js frontend built with Atlassian-inspired design tokens. The platform enables teams to manage projects through interactive Kanban boards with drag-and-drop task reordering, real-time activity logging, custom workflows, and workspace analytics.
